# Every idea — What can YOU [ ARKIV ] ? Ideathon

Every idea this repo can account for: **232** across three of the four tracks.

- **AI & DevTools** (78) and the open **Other** lane (87) have a published judging pack, so they are ordered by the panel's score. 4 placeholder/test entries are excluded — all three judges flagged them as carrying no Arkiv design.
- **Marketplaces** (67) was hosted and judged by Shantelle Awomoyi. This repo holds the submissions but not her scorecards, so that section is **alphabetical, not ranked** — the three prize winners are marked. 1 placeholder entry is excluded on content length.
- **DeFi** is not listed. Its window closed on 31 August, after the snapshot this file is built from, so the data here is partial — and half a track is worse than none.

Idea name and one-line pitch only — no participant names, contacts or wallets. Published under the showcase licence in [RULES §11](RULES.md) and the submission form's own showcase consent.

> **This order is not the verdict.** It is a three-model judging panel's non-binding first read. The prizes were decided by the human track hosts after an adversarial second pass, which is why the podium and this order differ. Prize-winning and specially-named entries are marked 🏆.

**Jump to:** [AI & DevTools](#ai--devtools--78-ideas) · [Other (open lane)](#other-open-lane--87-ideas) · [Marketplaces](#marketplaces--67-ideas)

## Marketplaces — 67 ideas

Alphabetical. This track's ranking belongs to its host, so no order is implied here beyond the three marked winners.

| Idea | One-line pitch |
| :--- | :--- |
| **AnchorFlow Protocol and PortSettle** | AnchorFlow turns weeks of B2B shipping disputes into instant, automated escrow payouts. |
| **ArkTasks AI** | An AI-driven Web3 task board that eliminates ghost listings using Arkiv’s self-pruning entities and cryptographic proof of authorship. |
| **AvailProof** | A B2B procurement marketplace where suppliers publish verifiable, time-bound capacity claims that buyers can query by quantity, price, location, and delivery deadline. |
| **Backhaul** | Backhaul lets carriers publish unused truck capacity for an upcoming route; shippers find it by lane, departure, equipment, capacity and rate, while every offer automatically expires at departure and carries verifiable proof of who published it. |
| **Beba** | Beba is a freight marketplace where posting a load and accepting a quote are the same entity changing hands - the moment a shipper accepts, ownership transfers on-chain from shipper to carrier, turning an open listing into a provable booking. No separate bookings table, ever. |
| **Bounty Microboard** | A bounty marketplace where dead listings self-prune and reviewer verdicts can be challenged and staked, so reviewer reputation is provable instead of platform-asserted. |
| **BountyRelay** | Portable cross-marketplace evidence for bounty claims, reviews, and provider-reported settlements—signed, queryable, expiring, and independently reconcilable. |
| **BountyTape** | BountyTape makes bug-bounty duplicate decisions independently verifiable through expiring, tamper-proof Arkiv receipts, while the actual vulnerability report stays private. |
| **BurstBay** | BurstBay is a live marketplace where apps and agents find, quote and reserve short-term API capacity. |
| **Carry** | Buyers own their purchase history as Arkiv entities and lend it to new marketplaces through scoped, self-expiring grants, so any storefront can personalise from the first page view. |
| **Cellgrade** | Cellgrade is a marketplace for second-life EV battery modules where independent test labs, not sellers, issue the graded listings, so buyers can find lots whose health measurements are still current enough for their use. |
| **CLAW** | An Agentic Marketplace Where Trust is the Currency. |
| **ClearRent** | ClearRent helps renters find available event equipment with current, creator-verifiable condition and handoff records from independent rental providers. |

| **Disclosure Window** | Researchers list a time-bounded exclusive first look; exclusivity ends when the Arkiv entity leaves the query surface. |
| **Dispute Evidence Packet** | A shared, tamper-proof evidence log for marketplace disputes. Both sides attach timestamped proof to an order, and neither can fabricate or backdate what they submitted. |
| **Fallow** | Fallow is a neutral live market for expiring CNC milling capacity, where buyers match against wallet-owned windows and accept seller-authored quotes. |
| **Farmtrace** | FarmTrace uses Arkiv’s decentralized database to bring farm-to-fork transparency, ensuring agricultural produce is authentic, fair, and trusted. |

| **Mocha Supply Exchange** | A direct marketplace connecting verified Kenyan coffee farmers with credible specialty buyers through fresh, verifiable live-lot listings and clearly labelled future-production signals. |
| **onpoint** | A fit-aware fashion marketplace where every listing, quote, and stock signal is a queryable, self-expiring, tamper-proof Arkiv entity — so human shoppers and AI agents browse the same verified inventory. |
